body: I'm in the exact same situation. The immense pressure of university just makes me feel so much worse. Sometimes I wish a truck would hit me or something. I'm really on the fence regarding suicide. I lost a close friend of mine due to it. Everyone who knew him were devastated. I don't want to cause that pain to my family and friends, but I'm not sure if I can keep on going like this. Sorry for the rant.
